props.name: cloud
props.description: The Computer runs in a cloud: hosted by Raft, or on a cloud provider the caller recognizes. Renders a cloud in place of `device`, with the same platform mark.

props.name: device
props.description: Device shape. `null`/omitted renders a generic monitor.

props.name: distro
props.description: Linux distribution, for the `linux` mark (see `computerDistro`). Drawn in place of Tux from 18px up; below that, and for `null` or an unknown value, the mark stays Tux. Ignored on other platforms.

props.name: platform
props.description: Platform corner mark. `null`/omitted (or an unknown value) renders no mark.
